name: Sunder Lash
description: Tear a lash of qi from the field and whip it at a foe to rip their veil.

name: Sunder Bind
description: Rend a rope from the field and cinch it round a foe so they cannot gather qi.

name: Sunder Salve
description: Fold the torn edges of the field over an ally or yourself and draw wounds shut.

name: Sunder Ward
description: Hold the sundered field close as a splintered ward that breaks the force of blows.

name: Sunder Tidefall
description: Burst the field outward as a heavy wave that splinters guards and bowls over those near.

name: Sunder Pike
description: Gather the field to a point and drive it through the guard and the body behind it.

name: Sunder Cleanse
description: Rip tainted qi from an ally's channels as the field passes through them and cast it out.

name: Breath Summoned Back
description: Pull the field in over an ally whose breath just stopped and force it to start again within moments.

name: Sunder Collapse
description: Let the field fall in on itself and crush the ground and all upon it.

name: Sunder Anchor
description: Drive splinters of the field into a foe's centre and fix their qi in place for a time.

name: Sunder Mending
description: Lay the torn field over allies and let it knit their wounds and renew their spent qi.

name: Sunder Zenith
description: The school's crowning stroke: the field is driven down on the whole front and pins all it touches.

name: Ruin Unbounded
description: Break the whole field outward at the destructive ceiling of the tier and ruin everything in its reach.

name: Unbound Thread
description: Cast a thread with no restraint on it and wind it round a foe without limit.

name: Unbound Pulse
description: Loose a pulse with nothing held back and let it land with the Core's whole weight.

name: Unbound Veil
description: Let the veil swell to its widest so it shields allies as well as the user.

name: Unbound Reading
description: Open the sense of qi without limit and read every living body within a great reach.

name: Unbound Tide
description: Send an unrestrained tide out from the Core that overruns the whole ground before it.

name: Unbound Lance
description: Drive an unrestrained lance of qi through whatever guard stands before it.

name: Unbound Return
description: Throw the whole reserve into an ally whose heart has just stopped and call their life back within moments.

name: Unbound Purge
description: Flood an ally's channels with clean qi to sweep out poison taint and any binding.

name: Unbound Rupture
description: Rupture the restraints of the qi at once and shake the flow of everything near.

name: Unbound Embrace
description: Wrap allies in an unbound embrace of qi that turns blows and mends them.

name: Unbound Verdict
description: Pass final judgment as a blow of unrestrained qi that fells the foe and pins them.

name: Unbound Ascendance
description: The school's crowning stroke: all restraint is cast away so the user and allies rise in power as foes fall.

name: Unbound Cataclysm
description: Loose every reserve of the Core at once as a blast at the destructive ceiling of the tier.

name: Qi Unmaking
description: Unmake the qi of the field at the ceiling of the tier and leave every foe without strength.

name: Last Thread
description: Send a last quiet thread to the dying and learn how much time remains to them.

name: Last Pulse
description: Strike with the last beat of divine qi in the arm so the blow ends the exchange.

name: Last Veil
description: Draw divine qi into a veil that holds to the final breath of the fight.

name: Last Tending
description: Give an ally a last full measure of divine mending to hold them back from the edge.

name: Last Tide
description: Send out the tide of the last breath as a wave that crushes all it meets.

name: Last Lance
description: Cast a single lance of divine qi that ends a foe's guard and their stand with it.

name: Last Return
description: Call back an ally whose breath and heart have just failed while the window of the last moments stands open.

name: Last Cleansing
description: Draw the last stain of curse taint and backlash from an ally and let it go with the breath.

name: Ending Wave
description: Cast a great wave of divine qi that ends every exchange within its reach.

name: Closing Seal
description: Set a closing seal of divine qi on a foe that shuts their techniques until it is lifted.

name: Last Mending
description: Pour the last divine mending over allies and lift their spent qi along with their wounds.

name: Last Judgment
description: The school's crowning stroke: judgment falls on the whole front and pins every foe in it.

name: Breath Concluded
description: End the breath of the whole field at the destructive ceiling of the tier and leave nothing standing.
